title: Activate accepted invitations from the 15-minute membership poll

outcomes.statement: A tenant-scoped membership poll detects acceptance and opens exactly one assignment while moving invited to active atomically and idempotently.
outcomes.demo: Poll before and after acceptance, verify one assignment and one invited-to-active transition, then replay with no duplicate.

uncertainties.statement: Whether this canonical child may inherit approved parent design authority without a separate child design.
uncertainties.resolution: The approved US-019 partition in docs/readiness/US-019.json, DEC-SMP-021/CHG-054 canonical allocation (docs/stories/CHANGES.md, CHG-054), the canonical generated child story docs/stories/sprint-3/r1_misc_us_066.md, and docs/superpowers/plans/2026-08-02-sprint-3-delivery.md section Task 7: Deliver US-019 provisioning and membership confirmation are the inherited design authority. Together they cover this child's allocated acceptance criteria and outcome, stable interfaces, company-scoped authorization, lifecycle/concurrency boundary, non-goals, and verification strategy. This reassessment introduces no new material uncertainty or scope outside that authority; no unresolved material uncertainty remains. The child implementation plan must cite these exact paths and the Task 7 US-019 section as its Spec authority; otherwise a child design is required.

actuals.root_cause: Measured from the readiness-bound plan commit at 2026-09-09T11:47:19Z through the sole authoritative campaign ending at 2026-09-09T18:18:33Z. The approved 224-minute assessment correctly predicted eight mutation shards but underestimated the cohesive boundary at 16 files versus 23 raw NUL-delimited Git paths. Four source/test commits and six adversarial review/fix loops added encrypted account-bound pagination resume, exact lifecycle/source-request locking, shared transactional provisioning-complete notification semantics, runtime composition, and gate hardening for the story-scoped mutation environment. Review remained below implementation time. Preview campaigns were repaired before the final cutoff and emitted no test_report. The one cache-cleared authoritative campaign ran all eight shards in 1,062 seconds, rounded once to 18 mutation minutes; it passed on first contact with a 94.46% aggregate score and a weakest shard of 91.18%. The 167-minute variance also includes diagnosis of two non-authoritative full-gate retries that exposed and then cleared stale exact-adapter and orphan Testcontainers state before the bounded two-worker pnpm check passed.
